instructions: Repair only the canonical RUN-313-007 verification failure on failed candidate 26da299170324543ec0cdb8ae8a0f16df6915693. Preserve the already-correct BO-1 direct-final AUTHOR_TASK implementation, normative documentation, origin-proof semantics, correction authoring semantics, TASK-313 r2 minimum-sufficient-v2 verification envelope, and all already-passing candidate behavior.

The five failing parametrizations are one causal defect in test_direct_author_task_uses_canonical_main_without_audit_projections. When the worktree is checked out on a non-upstream alternate branch, _resolve_remote(repo) delegates to resolve_transport_remote(repo), which resolves transport only from the current branch.
